name: MACS J2043.2-2144 (Hubble)
blurb: MACS J2043.2-2144, a galaxy cluster acting as a gravitational lens, seen by Hubble.
label: macsj2043-hubble
story: The gravity of the galaxy cluster MACS J2043.2-2144 works as a natural lens, stretching the light of a far more distant, dust-shrouded starburst galaxy into an arc.

claims.text: Program 14148 targets lensed submillimeter galaxies found by the Herschel Lensing Survey
The target behind MACSJ2043.2-2144 is a starburst galaxy lensed into an arc
MACS J2043.2-2144 is also RXCJ2043.2-2144, a cluster lensing a bright submillimeter galaxy
The lensed submillimeter source is HLS J204314.2-214439
